text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finding out about the changes Nishino Flower is going through, I decide to reassess her running style in order to make a new training regimen. However…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I just can't run right…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's clearly worried about how slow her times are compared to before. Still, her concern is understandable.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I don't know how to put it. I try to imagine how I want to move in my head…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But my legs step forward before I'm ready, and they won't move anything like I want them to…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Does that make sense?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's experiencing some disconnect with her body. Fortunately, that's nothing to be upset over.
choice_data_list: This growth spurt can only be a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so?
choice_data_list: Of course! Once you overcome this, you'll be stronger than ever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll do my best to master this new running style!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's so kind. But I can't let them do all the work for me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'll improve… I'm sure of it. I've just got to do my best to get past this and—)

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Of course, there will be difficulties she'll have to face too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Hm? That sounds like the school doctor and Trainer…)

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: It's true that the more an athlete grows, the more muscle they gain, which can lead to improvement. However…

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: An athlete's motor control is a delicate thing. Some fail to adapt to their body's changes and end up not being able to draw out their full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pitter-patter…

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Hm? If I recall, running isn't allowed in the hallways, correct? I could be wrong, though—I'm still wrapping my head around all the academy rules. In any case, while I do have some concerns…

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: In general, this is a very good thing that's happening. Keep a close eye on Nishino Flower during training, and do your best together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's the only one who can figure out how to get a sense for her changing body, but I can still support her as she tries. Speaking of which…
choice_data_list: Doctor, could I get your honest opinion on this training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (If I can't figure out how to adapt to my body, it won't just be about improving anymore. I might not even be able to continue as a racer…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I'll be able to do it… What do you think, little flowers?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I started cultivating this flower bed because I wanted to show it to Trainer. I've been secretly planting flowers in it for a while now, but…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did this cineraria get frostbitten?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Please don't wilt any more than this, okay? You'll make me even sadder…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's from Trainer… And they want me to meet them in their office?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drip, drop…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was rain in the forecast today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hope it's not too bad. I heard plants can get root rot from too much rain.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Every time I run in a race, I'll add more flowers. And once it's full of beautiful blossoms, it'll be time to show it off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She doesn't want any more flowers to wilt, hm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fshhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. Um, you wanted to talk to me?
choice_data_list: I've got a new training regimen for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pass Nishino Flower a regimen catered to her growth. But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What are these "A" and "B" labels for?
choice_data_list: They're different exercise patterns we can switch between at any time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I created the regimen after interviewing athletes who also continued to grow after becoming race-ready. I got their trainers' opinions, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right now, these exercises are only rough drafts to line up with her predicted growth, but I want to show her we can adapt quickly to anything that pops up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You came up with all of this in such a short amount of time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This kind of thing would have been difficult for me to do before I met Nishino Flower, but after coming so far alongside her…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I…
choice_data_list: I said you'd be able to improve once you overcome this, but there's something I forgot to add.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I didn't have the confidence to say it before, but now I'm confident in my ability to support and guide her through this.
choice_data_list: As long as we're together, it'll all be okay!
As long as we're together, it'll all be okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. You really are such a wonderful trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You've been working so hard for my sake, and here I am down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I think I turned into a bit of a scaredy-cat. But I'm fine now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work hard with you so I can beat my old self!
choice_data_list: Here's to a new and improved Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a while spent discussing our future plans with renewed resolve, Nishino Flower and I step out of my office.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Omigosh!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky?! What happened to you?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I was taking a nap, y'see. Took me a while to realize.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? What didn't you realize?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Gasp! It's pouring outside!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh no! My flower bed!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Your flower bed's fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I just walked by. Some kind person's put a tarp over it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's such a relief!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder who it was. I hope I can thank them properly one day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run out just to make sure the flowers are okay!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I told her they were fine. Well, what matters is that she's feeling better.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Cat got your tongue?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whatever could you mean?
